instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Once upon a time, there was a pregnant woman who craved the radishes growing in the neighbour’s garden.
Each night, her husband sneaked into the garden and stole the radishes.
But one night, the witch who owned the garden caught him stealing the radishes. The witch allowed him to take the radishes, but only on one condition: she would receive his child when his wife gave birth.
Soon after, the woman gave birth to a daughter and the witch returned to take the baby, naming her Rapunzel.

atoms.a: What did the man steal for his wife?
Why did the man steal radishes for his wife?
What did the man promise the witch?
b: that he wouldn’t steal any more radishes

instruction.text: Read the fairytale and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
The witch took the child with her and hid her in a high tower. There they lived, and Rapunzel grew up.
The only way to climb the tower was by crying out “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!”
Then the witch could use Rapunzel’s long hair to climb up.
But one day, a prince stood at the foot of the tower and called out the same words. He climbed the tower to reach Rapunzel, won her love and rescued her from the tower.

atoms.a: How was the witch able to climb the tower? Choose the two correct answers.
b: with the help of a prince
++with the words “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!”

atoms.a: How did the prince save Rapunzel?
b: ++by calling out the same words as the witch

instruction.text: Put the events of the story in the correct order, starting with what happened first.

atoms.b: The pregnant woman’s husband steals radishes from a witches garden.
The witch catches the man, and allows him to take the radishes if they give up their baby when it’s born.
The baby is born and the witch takes her, naming her Rapunzel.
The witch hides Rapunzel in a high tower, where she grows up.
The witch cries “Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!” to get up to the tower.
One day, a prince cries out the words to get up to the tower.
The prince climbs up, rescues Rapunzel, and they fall in love.
